messages:
liz_sales: Quick sync — retail prospect asking for a performance POC before legal exec sign-off. Goal they gave: p95 latency <200ms for chat completions, sustained 150-200 rps, daily peak 1.5M tokens. Need a short plan, runbook, and a cost estimate for a 2-week spike POC. Can we align this week?

omar_se: I can own the load plan and scripts. Two questions: are we running on Hosted API or Dedicated for the POC? That changes routing and quotas.

liz_sales: They prefer Dedicated so they can test isolation; want results that map to Dedicated SLA. Budgeting team also wants unit cost estimate (tokens + infra delta).

omar_se: OK. Plan draft: warm cache 10m, steady-state 30m at 200rps, 10m ramp down. Use k6 with a simple scenario that hits the chat endpoint and streams tokens. Measure p50/p95/p99, error rate, and GPU util. Example k6 snippet I will run:

```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check } from 'k6';
export let options = { vus: 200, duration: '30m' };
export default function() {
  let payload = JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-large-v1', input: 'Hello' });
  let res = http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat', payload, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $POC_KEY' } });
  check(res, { 'status 200': r => r.status === 200 });
}
```

omar_se: Will attach exact request shaping and token simulation file later.

ben_infra: For Dedicated — we can provision a 4-GPU pool with autoscale off to keep results deterministic. Need to know sequence length distribution (avg tokens per req). If they expect heavy context (2k tokens) that changes perf numbers. Also: we should bind them to a non-shared placement so other tenants don't affect results.

liz_sales: Good point — sales already asked them and they said avg 600 tokens/request, peak 2k for long sessions. Use 600 for steady-state, include a long-session test at 2k.

ben_infra: Perfect. I'll request the dedicated pool and reserve a test window. Also confirm KV cache warmup script to pre-populate common prefixes.

eva_security: Heads-up — prospect's procurement flagged two blockers: SAML SSO + a short SOC2 attestation. I can push SOC2 summary and the infra diagram but SAML requires configuration on their IdP side. Do they need SCIM?

liz_sales: They asked for SAML only for POC. SCIM not required until enterprise contract. Please send instructions for configuring an app and a test assertion.

eva_security: Will send a minimal SAML doc and a checklist. For SOC2, I'll attach the summary and the auditor contact. Expect 24h turnaround.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for the benchmark model at 2025-10-15T15:00:00Z. Notifying on-call.

omar_se: After the run, I'll produce a short results writeup with graphs (latency histograms, GPU util, token cost calc) and a clear statement: "Does this meet p95 <200ms on Dedicated with 600-token avg?"

sarah_sales: Pricing question: customer asked if we can offer a short-term POC discount — they want 40% off hosted list for the 2-week spike. What's our standard for Dedicated POCs?

liz_sales: For deals of this size we usually do a POC rate at 25% off list, and we can consider crediting overage if they convert within 60 days. Omar/Ben — any infra cost to call out?

ben_infra: Dedicated pool run costs will be X credits/day — I'll estimate exact GPU-hours after I provision, but expect the incremental infra delta to be ~ $2k–$4k over 2 weeks for a 4-GPU reservation.

omar_se: Sounds good. I'll include a cost table in the results: tokens (estimated), infra delta, and recommended discount lines.

liz_sales: Next steps: Omar to share k6 script + runbook by EOD tomorrow, Ben to confirm pool reservation window and cost by EOD, Eva to send SAML config + SOC2 summary, Sarah to prep the POC agreement language for 25% discount. Meeting to review results Wed at 10am PT. @omar_se can you run a short smoke test tonight at low qps to verify tooling? :thumbsup:

omar_se: Yep — I'll kick off a 5m smoke at 10pm PT and post logs.

ben_infra: Reserving pool for Wed morning, will DM the reservation ID.

eva_security: SAML doc sent to buyer contact and chart attached. SOC2 summary uploaded to the shared folder.

omar_se: Smoke test complete — no auth issues, minor 429s at bursts >250rps (expected). Will tune ramp in main run. Posting artifacts in the thread after full run.

liz_sales: Great work team, thanks. I'll update the buyer and lock the Wed review.

sarah_sales: Adding the buyer to the review invite.

omar_se: Post-run quick note: steady-state 30m at 200rps with 600-token avg -> p95 = 185ms, p99 = 420ms, error rate 0.4%. GPU util ~78%. Draft cost calc: ~1.1M tokens/day -> token cost $X, infra delta $Y. Will finalize in writeup.

liz_sales: Excellent — that's within their target. Can we add a short section in the writeup about follow-up mitigations for p99 spikes?

omar_se: Will include: batching tweaks, shorter context windows, and a fallback smaller model for heavy sessions.

liz_sales: Perfect. Meeting confirmed.
